mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM formal_agent_candidate_binding c JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND v.version_id=c.version_id AND v.content_sha256=c.content_sha256 AND v.entity_kind='AGENT_VERSION' AND v.owner_project_id <=> c.project_id JOIN agent_version a ON a.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND a.agent_version_id=c.version_id AND a.content_sha256=c.content_sha256 AND a.project_id <=> c.project_id JOIN configuration_head h ON h.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND h.config_id=a.agent_id AND h.kind='AGENT' AND h.current_version=a.agent_version_id AND h.project_id <=> a.project_id WHERE c.version_id=#{versionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT CONCAT(relation_kind,':',upstream_version_id) FROM lineage_edge WHERE consumer_version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY relation_kind,upstream_version_id
SELECT version_id FROM formal_agent_candidate_binding WHERE project_id <=> #{projectId} AND version_id > #{afterId} ORDER BY version_id LIMIT #{scanLimit}

SELECT r.* FROM agent_publication_record r JOIN capability_version c ON c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND c.capability_version=r.resource_id AND c.content_sha256=r.content_sha256 AND c.project_id <=> r.project_id WHERE r.kind='AUTHOR' AND c.kind IN ('TOOL','SKILL') AND r.resource_id=#{versionId}
